shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: A manual plunger backed up by an auto-launcher. It normally delivers to the WEB lanes, but a soft plunge parks the ball on the upper right flipper for the super skill shot.

shots.name: Green Goblin Targets
shots.notes: Five standups facing sideways along the far left wall. Complete all five and the next hit on any of them starts a Green Goblin battle.

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: Loops around the back to the WEB lanes normally, or straight to the upper right flipper when combos are live. Starts timed modes, collects Black Suit locks, and holds the extra ball light.

shots.name: Spinner
shots.notes: Sits in front of the left orbit. The points are small; the reason to rip it is that every spin adds 1,250 to the Venom Value.

shots.name: Light Lock Target
shots.notes: Look for one white standup on its own, tucked into the pocket where the left orbit meets the side ramp. Hit it to qualify Black Suit locks, and once you have cleared three full waves of villains, this target pays the Special.

shots.name: Side Ramp
shots.notes: Only really makeable from the upper right flipper. A black target in front of the Venom figure registers the shot. This is the shot that qualifies and advances Venom battles.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Makeable from any flipper — backhanded from the left, shot normally from the right, occasionally off a lucky bounce from up top. It advances early Venom battles but does not qualify them.

shots.name: Sandman 3-Bank
shots.notes: A raising and lowering three-bank guarding the centre shot. Hit the single strobing target as a one-time shot, or clear all three, and the bank drops out of the way.

shots.name: Sandman Inner Targets
shots.notes: Two yellow standups behind the three-bank, only reachable once it is down. They and the Sandman figure carry the battle values.

shots.name: The Sandman
shots.notes: The figure that blocks the centre hole. Hitting him scores double — both the points and the damage toward finishing the battle.

shots.name: Sandman Hole
shots.notes: The hole sits between the two inner standups. Finish your Sandman battles in it, and watch for locked balls, which the same hole launches straight up into the bumpers.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: Not a steep climb — the lane wraps around on itself up top and drops the ball into your right inlane. Come here to cash the Royale Jackpot while Battle Royale is running.

shots.name: Doc Ock Saucer
shots.notes: A mode-start saucer over on the right; when it ejects, your ball is returned by way of the right ramp exit. Keep shooting it to bring the Doc Ock figure down, and treat it as the Super Jackpot shot in every Doc Ock multiball.

shots.name: Doc Ock Figure & Magnet
shots.notes: A figure that lowers into play with a magnet in front of it. The magnet catches the ball and, in some rounds, throws it at Doc Ock for you.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Generally the easier of the two orbits. Starts timed modes and collects locks like the left one, and it can be backhanded off the right flipper if you want to show off.

shots.name: W-E-B Lanes
shots.notes: Three rollovers across the top. Spelling WEB advances the bonus multiplier, and the flashing lane is the standard skill shot.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers (3)
shots.notes: Lively, and worth deliberately feeding: every pop hit adds to the Black Suit Multiball jackpot value, which builds across the entire game rather than resetting.

shots.name: Spider Sense Targets
shots.notes: Three standups on the right, two red and one blue. Completing them arms the lane behind them with an award tied to whatever you currently have running.

shots.name: Spider Sense Lane
shots.notes: Behind the upper right flipper, and only reachable with that flipper raised. On a machine that is not level it has a nasty habit of feeding the right outlane.

shots.name: Upper Right Flipper
shots.notes: The flipper that makes the game work. It is the only reliable way to the side ramp and the only way into the Spider Sense lane.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Part of the H-E-R-O set spelled across the inlanes and outlanes, which is the other route to a bigger bonus multiplier.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Where the right ramp returns the ball. Also part of H-E-R-O.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Evenly spaced with the inlane, so a nudge saves it more often than not on default settings. Its insert flashes when Battle Royale is ready.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Same generous spacing as the left. Both outlanes flash when a Last Chance is armed.

goals.title: W-E-B Skill Shot
goals.summary: Plunge into the flashing WEB lane. It pays 250k the first time and 25k more each time after, adds five to your bonus multiplier, and doubles the pop bumper values for the rest of the ball. Make it on ball three and your end-of-ball bonus doubles, once per game.

steps.action: Full plunge into the flashing lane
steps.detail: The plunger normally delivers straight to the top lanes — landing the flashing one is the most under-rated shot on the machine for the bonus-multiplier boost alone.

goals.title: Super Skill Shot
goals.summary: Plunge weakly so the ball settles on the upper right flipper, then shoot the side ramp. It pays 500k rising by 50k, adds 100k to the Venom Value and puts you a step closer to a Venom battle. On ball three it triples your end-of-ball bonus.

steps.detail: Bring the ball down to the flippers — the skill shot is made with a flipper.

steps.action: Plunge through, then shoot the ramp off the upper flipper
steps.detail: You want the ball losing momentum near the top of the orbit and dropping onto the upper right flipper — the same flipper you'll use for the side ramp all game, so it's worth getting comfortable with. The ball save after this skill shot is very short, so have a plan for where the ball goes next.

goals.title: The White Arrows
goals.summary: Six major shots carry white spider arrows: both orbits, all three ramps and Doc Ock. Each one is worth 150k plus 12.5k per shot, and the sixth pays 350k. Clearing the set is the engine that drives both shot multipliers and the timed modes.

steps.detail: Both orbits, the left, right and side ramps, and the Doc Ock saucer.
When all six are done every arrow starts strobing, and that is your cue.

goals.title: Multiply A Shot
goals.summary: Once the arrows are strobing, the very next shot you make is multiplied by two for the rest of the ball. Choose deliberately — putting the multiplier on the side ramp or the right ramp is worth far more than putting it wherever the ball happened to go.
goals.reward: 2x on one shot for the ball, upgradeable to 3x

steps.action: Complete a set of white arrows
steps.detail: All six arrows lit, then everything strobes.

steps.action: Put the multiplier where it pays
steps.detail: The side ramp is the shot you will repeat most during Venom battles and Black Suit supers.
Finishing the mode the arrows just lit upgrades that multiplied shot from 2x to 3x.

goals.title: The Three Waves
goals.summary: Four villains, three levels each. The game is structured around clearing them a wave at a time, and each completed wave hands you something substantial. Everything else on the machine is in service of this ladder.
goals.reward: Extra ball, then Battle Royale, then a Special
instructions: Wave one — beat Sandman, Doc Ock, Green Goblin and Venom once each. That lights the extra ball at the left orbit.
Wave two — beat all four a second time. That lights both orbits for Battle Royale.
Wave three — beat all four a third time. The Light Lock target then goes lit for a Special.
Battles stack freely, so run several at once wherever you can. The only restriction is that progress toward the next Doc Ock battle pauses until the current one ends.
Sandman is qualified at the three-bank, Doc Ock at his saucer, Green Goblin at the five-target bank, Venom at the side ramp. Learn which shot feeds which villain and you can pick your stack.
Get a Doc Ock multiball running early. With extra balls in play, the Sandman targets and the Light Lock target stop being scary — clang one off either and it costs you almost nothing.

goals.title: Sandman Battles
goals.summary: Clear the three-bank, either target by target or with a one-time shot at the strobing target, and the bank drops to expose the two inner standups and Sandman himself. Hitting Sandman is worth double both in points and in damage.
goals.reward: 2M, then 4M, then 6M for the three levels

steps.detail: Hitting the single strobing target as it moves clears the whole bank in one shot.

steps.action: Aim at Sandman, not the standups
steps.detail: His hits count twice, so the mode takes half as long if you can hit him consistently.
Six target hits for the first battle, eight for the second and twelve for the third, then the centre hole to close it out.

goals.title: Doc Ock Multiballs
goals.summary: The only villain whose battles are multiballs. Shots to the saucer lower the figure, and a magnet in front of it does some of the work for you. Each of the three rounds is built differently, and the third is the most lucrative round in the game.
goals.reward: 250k jackpots up to a cumulative Super

steps.detail: One saucer shot for the first battle, three for the second.

steps.action: Let the magnet do the work
steps.detail: In the first and third rounds the magnet throws the captured ball at Doc Ock for a free jackpot.
Five jackpots lights a Super worth five times the base in the first round; in the later rounds it is the sum of everything you have collected.
Doc Ock stacks with Black Suit Multiball in either order, and you can make progress on both at once.

goals.title: Green Goblin Battles
goals.summary: The simplest villain to understand and the most dangerous to shoot at. Complete the five-target bank with a hit on each, then hit any of them again to start. From there you just keep hitting the flashing green targets until he is done.
goals.reward: 3M, then 4M, then 6M for the three levels

steps.action: Hit all five, then one more
steps.detail: That extra hit is what actually starts the battle.
Direct hits on a lit target score more than glancing hits on an unlit one.
Six hits for the first battle, eight for the second and twelve for the third.

goals.title: Venom Battles
goals.summary: Everything Venom runs through the side ramp, which means everything Venom runs through the upper right flipper. One ramp shot starts the first battle; the two after that each need four side ramp shots just to qualify.
goals.reward: A hurry-up, then repeated Venom Value payouts

steps.detail: The left ramp advances Venom battles but does not qualify them — only the side ramp counts down.
The first battle is the only timed one. Both the left ramp and the side ramp are lit, the value opens at a million and falls to 500k, and each shot resets it and adds 250k. Four shots finishes it.

steps.action: Use both ramps in the second battle
steps.detail: Six shots to either ramp, each paying the Venom Value.
Eight side ramp shots, no substitutions. This is where a shot multiplier on the side ramp pays for itself.

goals.title: Build The Venom Value
goals.summary: A running value that starts at 250k and caps at 750k, and it holds from ball to ball. Two Venom battles pay it on every shot, and a plain side ramp collects it any time. Feeding it early makes the later battles worth several times more.

steps.detail: Every spin adds 1,250 — the cheapest and most repeatable way to build it.
Each one adds 100k, which is eighty spinner rotations in a single plunge.
A normal side ramp shot pays the current value, and finishing a Venom battle adds 25k.

goals.title: Black Suit Multiball
goals.summary: The traditional multiball. Hit the Light Lock target until the locks light at the orbits, then shoot a green-lit orbit three times to start. Two jackpots sit at each major shot, and the jackpot value grows across the whole game from pop bumper hits.
goals.reward: Twelve jackpots, then four Super Jackpots

steps.detail: How many hits it takes depends on the settings and on how many Black Suit Multiballs you have already played.
Either green-lit orbit works, and the third one starts multiball immediately.
The jackpot base starts at 250k on ball one and climbs 500 points per pop hit for the rest of the game, so bumper time is never wasted.
After all twelve jackpots, two Super pairs light at the left ramp at four times value and two at the side ramp at eight times. Clear all four and the regular jackpots start again.

goals.title: Spider Sense
goals.summary: Complete the three Spider Sense targets and the lane behind them arms with an award based on whatever mode, villain or multiball is running. The awards stack and they stay lit until you collect them or the ball ends.
goals.reward: Mode time, added value, and add-a-balls

steps.detail: Each completion adds one award, assigned to your active modes in the order you started them.

steps.action: Collect with the upper flipper raised
steps.detail: The lane is only reachable with that flipper up, and one trip through collects everything currently lit.
Add-a-ball is available once per multiball, but it may sit behind an earlier mode's award — so complete the targets again to push through to it.

steps.action: Stack two multiballs for two add-a-balls
steps.detail: With Doc Ock and Black Suit running together it is possible to earn a separate add-a-ball from each.

goals.title: The Five Timed Modes
goals.summary: Completing a set of white arrows also lights both orbits to start one of five forty-second modes, listed above the flippers. Finishing any of them upgrades your multiplied shot to 3x, and starting all five is a requirement for the game's final challenge.
goals.reward: Mode points, plus a 3x shot multiplier

steps.detail: The mode that starts is the next one in the list above the flippers.

New Goblin is six ramp shots, alternating left and right for more; Daily Bugle alternates the Spider Sense targets with a major shot three times; The Amazing Spider-Man is all six major shots; Bonesaw is 100 switch hits; Rescue MJ is eight roving lit shots.

steps.action: Buy time if you are short
steps.detail: The Spider Sense lane adds time to a running timed mode.

goals.title: Battle Royale
goals.summary: Beat all four villains twice and both orbits light for it. Every shot on the playfield is lit at 250k, the four villain shots pay 750k the first time each, and everything you collect is added into a Royale Jackpot waiting at the right ramp.
goals.reward: A Royale Jackpot of at least 3,250,000 in round one

steps.detail: Battle Royale does not stack with Black Suit Multiball, so clear that first if it is running.
Once all four are hit, the Royale Jackpot lights and the villains stop scoring — Venom aside.

steps.action: Pad the jackpot before you cash it
steps.detail: Every shot you make is added to the jackpot first. Grinding the left orbit is a safe way to build it and your bonus at the same time, and completing every red spider shot adds another 1,500,000.
That resets the jackpot, advances the round and adds a ball for the first two rounds. From round three onward Venom must be taken via the side ramp, not the left.

goals.title: Last Chance
goals.summary: When Battle Royale is ready to start, both outlane inserts flash. Drain in that state and the game immediately replunges the ball rather than taking it — a deliberate mercy so that nobody loses a ball on the doorstep of the best mode in the game.

steps.detail: That is the tell that Battle Royale is qualified and a Last Chance is armed.
Do not spend the reprieve on anything else — get to an orbit.

goals.title: Extra Ball And Special
goals.summary: Both of the game's big awards sit behind the villain waves. Finish the first wave and the extra ball lights at the left orbit. Finish the third — all four villains beaten three times each — and the Light Lock target holds a Special.

steps.action: Collect the wave one extra ball
steps.detail: It lights the moment the fourth villain of the first wave goes down.

steps.action: Go back for the Special after wave three
steps.detail: The same lone standup you have been using to qualify locks all game becomes the Special collect.

goals.title: H-E-R-O And W-E-B
goals.summary: Two separate letter sets both feed the bonus multiplier. HERO is spelled across the inlanes and outlanes, so you collect it just by playing; WEB is the top lanes. The skill shot is worth five multipliers on its own, which dwarfs both.

steps.detail: The inlanes and outlanes carry the letters, so ordinary play advances it.
Orbit shots feed the lanes when combos are not diverting the ball to the upper flipper.

steps.action: Do not skip the skill shot
steps.detail: One WEB lane skill shot is worth five multiplier steps, and on ball three it doubles the whole bonus.

goals.title: Stack Everything
goals.summary: This game rewards running several things at once more than almost any other Stern of its era. Battles stack with each other and with multiballs, and every stack multiplies the value of the shots you were going to take anyway.
goals.reward: Several progress bars moving on one shot

steps.action: Start a mode before your third lock
steps.detail: Anything running when the third lock lands comes into Black Suit Multiball with you.
Doc Ock and Black Suit stack in either order, and you can progress toward one while playing the other.
Every battle except Doc Ock can be qualified, advanced and completed while Black Suit Multiball is running.

achievements.title: Web Slinger
achievements.desc: Plunge into the flashing WEB lane for the skill shot.

achievements.title: Soft Plunge
achievements.desc: Catch a soft plunge on the upper flipper and make the side ramp.

achievements.title: All Six Arrows
achievements.desc: Complete a full set of white spider arrows.

achievements.title: Triple Threat
achievements.desc: Upgrade a multiplied shot to 3x by finishing the timed mode.

achievements.title: Maximum Venom
achievements.desc: Build the Venom Value all the way to its 750k ceiling.

achievements.title: Black Suit
achievements.desc: Lock three balls and start Black Suit Multiball.

achievements.title: Eight Times Value
achievements.desc: Reach the side ramp Super Jackpots in Black Suit Multiball.

achievements.title: Double Multiball
achievements.desc: Have Doc Ock and Black Suit Multiball running at the same time.

achievements.title: Friendly Neighborhood
achievements.desc: Beat all four villains once to light the extra ball.

achievements.title: Battle Royale
achievements.desc: Beat all four villains twice and start Battle Royale.

achievements.title: Three Waves Deep
achievements.desc: Beat every villain three times and collect the Special.

drills.title: Soft Plunge To The Upper Flipper
drills.text: Plunge weakly so the ball loses momentum near the top of the orbit and settles on the upper right flipper, then take the side ramp from there. It is the same flipper and the same ramp you will be living on all game, so this is the cheapest way to get comfortable with both.

drills.title: Own The Side Ramp
drills.text: Everything Venom runs through the side ramp, and the side ramp only really exists from the upper right flipper — the left ramp advances battles but never qualifies them. Spend a ball trapping up top and alternating the side ramp with the Spider Sense lane until that flipper stops feeling like a spare.
drills.reps: one full ball, upper flipper only

drills.title: Decide Before The Sixth Arrow
drills.text: Sweep the six white arrows — both orbits, all three ramps and the Doc Ock saucer — and every arrow starts strobing. The next shot you make is doubled for the rest of the ball, so pick where it is going before you clear the sixth rather than letting the ball choose for you.
drills.reps: 3 sets, multiplier placed on purpose each time

drills.title: Feed The Venom Value
drills.text: The Venom Value holds from ball to ball, so build it before the battles rather than during them: every spinner rip adds to it and a super skill shot is worth dozens of spins in a single plunge. Collect it on any plain side ramp shot as you go past.
drills.reps: one ball spent building, then cash it

drills.title: Lock Chain, Pops In Between
drills.text: Hit the lone white standup until the locks light, then take a green-lit orbit three times — the third starts multiball immediately. Feed the pops between locks, because the jackpot base climbs with every bumper hit and it builds across the whole game instead of resetting.

drills.title: Nudge, And Read The Outlanes
drills.text: The outlanes are spaced evenly with the inlanes, so a nudge saves more balls here than you would expect — practise it instead of watching them go. Learn the tell as well: both outlane inserts flashing means Battle Royale is qualified and a drain gets replunged, so spend that reprieve on an orbit and nothing else.
drills.reps: nudge every outlane-bound ball for one game

actionButton.how: Stern built this one years before it started bolting a button onto the lockdown bar, so the flippers are all you press. Your other control is the shooter rod, and it is worth dialling in: a full plunge into the flashing WEB lane pays and hands you five bonus multipliers, a soft one sets up the super skill shot off the upper right flipper. An auto-plunger takes over when the game needs to feed the ball itself.

howItPlays.objective: Spider-Man is a stacking-heavy Stern built around four villains -- Sandman, Doc Ock, Green Goblin and Venom -- each fought three times. Clear them wave by wave -- the first sweep hands you an extra ball, the second opens Battle Royale, the third lights a Special -- while running as many battles and multiballs together as you can hold.
loop: Learn which shot wakes which villain: the three-bank drops for Sandman, the saucer lowers Doc Ock, the standup wall starts Green Goblin, and the side ramp off the upper right flipper drives Venom.
Sweep the six white spider arrows to arm a shot multiplier and to light one of five timed modes at the orbits.
Down the whole roster once for the extra ball, a second full pass to unlock Battle Royale, a third for the Special.
Qualify locks at the Light Lock target and start Black Suit Multiball, stacking it with a Doc Ock multiball and any running battle.
Work the spinner and the pops in the background -- one builds the Venom Value, the other grows the Black Suit jackpot across the whole game.

lights.name: The Villain Waves
lights.lit: Each villain arms at a shot of its own: Sandman when you drop the three-bank, Doc Ock through his saucer, Green Goblin once the five standups fall, and Venom by way of the side ramp. Whichever is lit stays a live battle until you finish its current level, and a villain already put down stays down as you climb the three waves.
lights.then: Put all four villains down once and an extra ball lights at the left orbit; a second full sweep opens Battle Royale across both orbits; a third arms the Special back at that lone Light Lock standup. Battles stack freely, so keep a few going at once.

lights.name: The White Arrows
lights.lit: A white spider arrow rides on each of the six major shots -- both orbits, every ramp, and the Doc Ock saucer. A lit arrow is one still owed, and once the last one goes on the whole set strobes as your cue.
lights.flashing: Once they strobe, the next shot you take, whatever it is, gets doubled for the rest of that ball -- so steer it onto the side ramp or right ramp rather than wherever the ball happens to land.
lights.then: Completing the set also lights the orbits for a timed mode -- one of five that each run about forty seconds -- and finishing that mode bumps your multiplied shot from double to triple. Starting all five of them counts toward the game's final challenge.

lights.name: Venom & the Side Ramp
lights.lit: Venom lives entirely on the side ramp, which is only makeable off the upper right flipper -- so owning that little flipper is the whole battle. One ramp shot begins the timed opening fight; each of the two that follow needs four side-ramp hits just to qualify, and a plain side ramp always banks the current Venom Value.
lights.then: Build the Venom Value early -- the spinner adds a little on every rip and a super skill shot adds a lot -- because two of the battles pay that value on every shot, so a fat value makes the later fights worth many times as much. This is the shot to spend a multiplier on.

lights.name: Doc Ock Multiballs
lights.lit: Doc Ock is the one villain whose battles are multiballs. Saucer shots count the figure down until he lowers into play, and a magnet planted in front of him snatches the ball and, some rounds, hurls it straight back at him for a free jackpot.
lights.then: Collect jackpots at the saucer until five light a Super, and make the saucer your super-jackpot target every round -- the third Doc Ock round is the richest feature the game has. It also stacks cleanly with Black Suit Multiball, started in whichever order you like.

lights.name: Black Suit Multiball
lights.lit: Pound the lone Light Lock standup to qualify the locks, watch both orbits go green, then lock three balls there -- the third one launches multiball straightaway. A pair of jackpots waits at every major shot.
lights.then: Feed the pop bumpers whenever you can beforehand, because the jackpot base climbs a little on every pop hit and never resets, so it grows all game. Clear all twelve and two Super pairs arm -- one at the left ramp worth quadruple, one at the side ramp worth eightfold -- and beating those relights the ordinary jackpots.

lights.name: W-E-B & H-E-R-O
lights.lit: Two letter sets both feed your end-of-ball bonus multiplier: W-E-B across the three top rollovers, and H-E-R-O across the inlanes and outlanes, which you spell just by playing. A lit letter is one still owed.
lights.flashing: The flashing top lane is the standard skill shot -- a full plunge into it pays, jumps your bonus multiplier by five, and keeps the pop bumpers paying double until the ball drains.
lights.then: Complete either word to step the multiplier, but the skill shot dwarfs both in a single plunge -- and landing it on your third ball doubles the entire end-of-ball bonus, once a game.

lights.name: Spider Sense
lights.lit: Complete the trio of Spider Sense standups and the lane tucked behind them lights an award, its nature set by whichever mode, villain or multiball you have going -- extra mode time, added value, or an add-a-ball. The awards pile up and hold their light until you either cash them or lose the ball.
lights.then: Collect them all in one pass through the Spider Sense lane, which opens only with the upper right flipper held up. In a multiball you can push through to an add-a-ball by completing the targets a second time, and stacking two multiballs can hand you an add-a-ball from each.

scoring.text: Dial in the plunge. Sent hard into the flashing WEB rollover it pays and lifts your bonus multiplier by five; feathered soft, it dies on the upper right flipper, the platform every super skill shot launches from. Then chip the villains down one by one -- the first full sweep lights your extra ball at the left orbit.

Stack everything. Sweep the white arrows for a shot multiplier and a timed mode, get a Doc Ock multiball going so the scary targets stop mattering, and qualify Black Suit Multiball with a battle already running so it comes along for the ride.

Beat all four villains twice to light Battle Royale, the best mode on the machine -- every shot is lit, the four villains pay a premium, and it all piles into a Royale Jackpot you cash at the right ramp. Beat them a third time for the Special; and if both outlanes flash, a Last Chance replunges you rather than let you drain on the doorstep.
